final_sql: SELECT s.Name, s.Capacity, COUNT(*) AS n FROM concert c JOIN stadium s ON CAST(c.Stadium_ID AS INT)=s.Stadium_ID WHERE CAST(c.Year AS INT) > 2013 GROUP BY s.Stadium_ID ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5
answer:
The stadium with the most concerts after 2013 is **Somerset Park**, with a capacity of **11,998**. It hosted 2 concerts in that period. No other stadium hosted more than 1, so there is no tie.

I took "after 2013" to mean years strictly greater than 2013, so 2014 onward and not 2013 itself. The `Year` column is stored as text, so I cast it to an integer before comparing.
